methods.label: Align decimal places
methods.levelReason: Adding one- and two-place decimals by aligning decimal points is explicitly within Grade 4.

candidate.annotationRationale:
The target and retained method are decimal addition under cnm_p125. Decimal place value under cnm_p118 supports aligning tenths and hundredths and writing 0.4 as 0.40.
